feature: Current-source fixed-cumulus and unused type-lookup candidates under native fixed-ray and ordinary sky controls
status: Investigation only; no production change or accepted optimization. No image or native-buffer threshold relaxed.
scope: Main thread only. No playthrough, package, export, engine/helper rebuild, APK or install. Existing private desktop runtime with explicitly frozen current cloud/volume/sky source substitution; unchanged runtime services remain in its PCK. No full-current-source package or matching-device acceptance.

current_source_verification.scope: Cloud source substitutes its current local Volume preload; Sky omits only global class registration. Runtime services and unchanged res:// dependencies come from the reused private PCK; not complete-current-source package acceptance.

normal_rendering_cost.scope: 4K isolated background-only sky, ordinary camera and default sky debanding. Not whole-game FPS.

fixed_cumulus.same_input_native_failure: Fair weather, recorded rays, sky shader debanding removed: 97 checks / 1 failure. Candidate changes seven native RGBA16F pixels, nine scattering channel values, each by one half-float code. Peak absolute scatter delta 0.000244140625; alpha/transmittance remains exact. All held, repeat and restored-reference native controls and all final images are exact. This is new evidence beyond the earlier 128x64 HDR test, and prevents an exact-output claim for this candidate.

changed_pixels.scope: Native half-resolution cloud buffer expanded losslessly from RGBA16F. Diagnostic fixed rays and sky debanding disabled. Seven candidate-versus-reference scattering pixels; alpha/transmittance remains bit-identical everywhere. All held, repeat and restored native controls are exact.

fixed_cumulus.mixed: The same recorded-ray/no-sky-debanding control has exact native cloud buffers but a 57-pixel / peak1 final-image difference between candidate and reference. 97 checks / 1 failure. Held, repeat and restoration controls pass.
fixed_cumulus.decision: Retain as rejected for exact-output promotion; do not describe the 10.5% saving as accepted or deployed.

lookup_only.change: Skip only the type-noise texture fetch when type spread is exactly zero. Use .5 for that otherwise unused sample; preserve the remaining original density expression. All other source bytes remain identical. This is a smaller previously inconclusively timed candidate, re-evaluated because fixed-cumulus now has a same-input native failure.

fixed_input_acceptance.limit: Both runs use a diagnostic recorded-ray texture and disable the Sky use_debanding render mode. These are math/isolation controls, not production appearance or performance acceptance.

direct_hdr.scope: Current eabc8d9 High integrator versus the guarded unused type-noise lookup, HDR scattering and transmittance, including rays originating below/inside/above the cloud layer. No gameplay route or FPS claim.

performance.scope: 4K isolated background-only sky, ordinary camera and default sky debanding. Not whole-game FPS.

timed_process_isolation.scope: Process observations sampled approximately every 0.25s. A foreign game was observed during startup, through +5.704s. None observed in the timed arms or a 0.5s margin. Full-run isolation is not claimed.

ordinary_fair.limit: A different project runs during startup through +5.704s. No competing engine is observed in any timed arm or a 0.5s margin; the first timed arm begins at +11.802s. About 3.36% is a measured candidate result with this stated isolation limit, not an accepted whole-game improvement.

lookup_only.ordinary_mixed: 87 checks / 6 failures. Native candidate-held, candidate-versus-reference and restored-reference comparisons differ at 50,055 pixels; final sky at 5,072 pixels / peak4. Native hashes exactly match the two previously documented original renderer states. The unchanged reference also changes on restoration. This does not isolate the candidate as the cause; another project is observed during the run, and no timing claim is made.
lookup_only.decision: Scratch-only pending ordinary renderer stability and complete platform qualification. A passing diagnostic substitution must not bypass the failed ordinary controls.

all_run_totals.meaning: Includes retained real failures. Not a release-acceptance total.

limits: All GPU timing is RTX3090 Ti / Forward+, 3840x2160 background-only High sky with the real owner Environment and cloud_radiance=false; no reflection/ground work and no whole-game FPS claim.
No driver, compiler, floating-point contraction or other single root cause is proved.
The 31.640625 MiB fixed-ray texture is diagnostic only. It is constructed from earlier component maps, not simultaneous vector capture or a runtime cache proposal.
Foreign engine work is recorded and never stopped or modified. lookup-cost-fair01, lookup-native-mixed01 and lookup-fixed-mixed01 observe another project; other runs observe none.
The broad HDR fixture uses 110 combinations / 901120 rays, 11 weather/type cases, two quadrature settings and five altitudes; it cannot substitute for native Sky-stage checks.
Original RMX3890/Adreno610 first-load/settings and RTX3050/CachyOS report-device verification, Windows, full-current-source package acceptance and separate Adreno650 Mobile water flicker remain open.
next_actions: Do not retry fixed-cumulus as an exact candidate without a concrete arithmetic change that addresses the seven native scattering differences.

Keep the smaller lookup guard scratch-only until ordinary camera/sky controls pass. Fixed-input equivalence is now established in the fair/mixed fixtures and broad HDR cases; repeating that same grid adds no evidence.

Resolve the known upstream viewing-ray/final-sky variation before claiming complete sky stability or attributing these normal-rendering failures to either optimization. Preserve current seam repair, High bounds and accepted unused reflection-ray skip.
Continue source work without playthroughs or unsolicited packages; no device-porting or new build is justified solely by these rejected/pending candidates.
